title: BMW M Series
heroDescription: Specialized care, performance diagnostics, and precision repairs for BMW M2, M3, M4, M5, and M8 models.
spotlightDescription: High-performance BMW M models demand specialized expertise. We provide precision diagnostics, performance maintenance, and repairs to keep your M Series delivering the power, handling, and driving experience it's built for.

title: BMW X Series
heroDescription: Complete xDrive AWD, suspension, cooling, and scheduled maintenance for BMW X1 through X7 SUVs.
spotlightDescription: BMW X Series SAVs combine luxury comfort with all-wheel-drive capability. Our Sacramento specialists handle xDrive transfer case service, air suspension repair, cooling systems, and heavy-duty brake maintenance.

title: BMW Sedans
heroDescription: Dealer-level maintenance, engine care, and electronics diagnostics for BMW 3, 5, and 7 Series sedans.
spotlightDescription: From nimble 3 Series daily drivers to flagship 7 Series executive sedans, we provide factory-level oil service, gasket and timing repairs, suspension restoration, and module diagnostics to keep your sedan refined and reliable.

title: BMW Coupes & Gran Coupes
heroDescription: Precision chassis, drivetrain, and performance maintenance for 2, 4, 8, and Z Series BMWs.
spotlightDescription: Designed for spirited driving and sleek grand touring, BMW Coupes and Gran Coupes rely on razor-sharp steering, tight suspension geometry, and responsive powertrains—all serviced with OEM-quality parts in our shop.

title: Classic BMWs
heroDescription: Dedicated mechanical care for heritage BMWs including 2002, E30, E36, E46, E39, and E60 models.
spotlightDescription: With 30+ years of experience starting with a 1974 BMW 2002 restoration, our shop is trusted by classic BMW enthusiasts across Sacramento, the Bay Area, Arizona, and Oregon for mechanical sorting, VANOS rebuilds, and OEM parts sourcing.
